structured_output.title: DNS caching feature affects cert-manager core
structured_output.content: This change modifies internal DNS zone lookup behavior in cert-manager's DNS01 challenge resolver. The environment runs cert-manager (manifests show cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate apiVersion in use) with 1 installed CRD. The improvement caches DNS responses and handles TTL expiration in FindZoneByFqdn, affecting any DNS01 ACME challenges. Although the environment summary does not explicitly state whether DNS01 challenges are configured, the presence of global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole suggests alternative challenge methods may be in use. Verify whether your cert-manager deployment uses DNS01 issuers or challenges; if so, inspect the release notes for any behavioral changes in DNS resolution.
